summary: Combines the __int16 argument a1 with the 16-bit stack local v2: returns a1 | (v2 & 0xFCFF). The mask 0xFCFF clears bits 8 and 9 of v2 before the OR, so those two result bits come only from a1. v2 is read before any write, so its origin is not evidenced; the function is called from tire-model and rigid-body physics initialization and integration paths.

operations.description: Bitwise AND of the 16-bit stack local v2 with 0xFCFF, clearing bits 8 and 9.
Bitwise OR of argument a1 with the masked v2 value.
On the frame path; invoked by tire model, rigid-body and physics integration routines.

unresolved: v2 is read uninitialized in the decompiled source; it is likely leftover stack state (possibly a control word whose bits 8 and 9 the mask strips), but no packet evidence grounds that.
The purpose of forcing bits 8 and 9 from a1 while ORing the remaining bits is not established.
The canonical label 'EmptyStub_7780' describes this as a stub, but the raw source performs a real bitwise operation.
